channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Was the Iran war the final blow in the collapse of Spirit Airlines?
item.description: The shutdown of the budget airline after 34 years has left 17,000 staff members unemployed.

item.title: OPEC+ announces symbolic oil output rise during Strait of Hormuz closure
item.description: Seven major producers will add 188,000 barrels per day to their total production quota for June, OPEC+ says.

item.title: What’s Iran’s 14-point proposal to end the war? And will Trump accept it?
item.description: Trump is reviewing Iran's latest proposal to end the war, but the mistrust between the two sides is a big obstacle.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz blockade and other major naval sieges in modern times
item.description: Naval blockades are among the oldest weapons of war, using sea control to cut supplies and force an enemy’s surrender.

item.title: The Iran war has strengthened Ukraine in surprising ways. Could a ceasefire with Russia be closer?
item.description: President Zelensky has been visiting the Gulf to demonstrate his country's military nous.

item.title: The clandestine network smuggling Starlink tech into Iran to beat internet blackout
item.description: Sahand tells the BBC World Service he sends satellite internet terminals into Iran to help show "the real picture".

item.title: Concern for jailed Iranian Nobel laureate as family say health deteriorating
item.description: On Friday her family said the 54-year-old had been taken from prison to a local hospital after a sharp deterioration in her health.

item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
item.description: Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire.

item.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
item.description: The president writes that hostilities "have terminated" because of the ceasefire, arguing he does not need congressional authorisation.

item.title: Billions of meals at risk due to Iran war, says fertiliser boss
item.description: A shortage of fertiliser due to the Iran conflict could reduce crop yields and push prices higher, says the boss of Yara.
